liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Bob performed exceptionally well during the performance of Looks Like Rain [13]
- **The Other One** (1 review): The Other One and Not Fade Away were strong, high-energy performances [19]
- **All Along The Watchtower** (1 review): The performance of All Along The Watchtower was terrific enough to be included on the album [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-07-26.141759.sbd.miller.flac2496** (recommended): soundboard; 32 songs; 229 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1987-07-26.148616.mtx.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 32 songs; 225 min [3]
- **gd1987-07-26.148618.5-1.tobin.flac1648**: source not stated; 32 songs; 225 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd1987-07-26.sbd-set3.unknown.97495.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 15 songs; 90 min; rated 3.8/5 by 5 [9]. Said about its sound: The recording features muddy bass and audience screaming coming from all directions [16]

## Around the show

- Phil attempted to simulate a Southern California earthquake using sonic bombs on Shakedown Street [11]
- Weir wore a Madonna t-shirt, which was not visible on the board tape [14]
- Bobby was distracted fighting in the front row while people clashed with staff [17]
- It was very hot when the band took the stage, and many attendees were high on LSD [17]
- A makeshift NA meeting occurred in the outfield with orange helium balloons released [22]
- Numerous Phil bombs occurred during the beginning of the Shakedown Street performance [6]
- The reviewer considers this specific Shakedown Street performance to be their absolute favorite [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-07-26.141759.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [1]
- **gd1987-07-26.148616.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by SBD + AUD Matrix 3 Source Mix (44/16) by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 3 Source Mix (44/16) [3]. Also: The file was mixed by an archive.org user and converted to FLAC in December 2019 [3]
- **gd1987-07-26.148618.5-1.tobin.flac1648**: transferred by 5.1 LPCM Surround Sound Mix (48k) by Kevin Tobin; source: 5.1 LPCM Surround Sound Mix (48k) [5]. Also: The file is 5.1 LPCM Surround Sound, mixed in Adobe Audition CC 2014 by an archive.org user [5]
- **gd1987-07-26.sbd-set3.unknown.97495.shnf**: source: Soundboard (audience starting with Ballad of a Thin Man) [9]
